cases.name: add
cases.input:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
  annotations:
    hero: batman
    fiend: riddler
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
  annotations:
    hero: batman
    fiend: riddler
    auto: ford
    bean: cannellini
    clown: emmett kelley
    dragon: smaug
cases.go:
input: <input>,
expectedOutput: <expectedOutput>,
filter: Filter{Annotations: annoMap{
"clown":  "emmett kelley",
"auto":   "ford",
"dragon": "smaug",
"bean":   "cannellini",
}},

cases.name: yaml_1_1_compatibility

apiVersion: example.com/v1

  name: instance
  annotations:
    hero: batman
    fiend: riddler
